title: The Essence of Learning
simplified_paragraphs: 曾经，有一个学生对自己的老师说："老师！您可以把您智慧的精华都告诉我吗？这样我就能变得像您一样聪明了。”

老师笑了笑，然后拿起一个苹果，大大地咬了一口。老师看着他的学生，嘴里不断咀嚼着苹果。过了一会儿，老师把已经嚼烂的苹果吐在手中，伸出手对这个学生说："把这些吃下去！"学生惊讶地说："老师！这……这怎么能吃呢？”老师说："我咀嚼过的苹果，你知道不能吃。其实，我拥有的智慧的精华就像这咀嚼过的苹果，我可以直接给你，但它已经失去了原来新鲜而甜美的滋味了。学习需要亲自去咀嚼和体会，许多答案只有经过你自己的思考才能得到。”
traditional_paragraphs: 曾經，有一個學生對自己的老師說："老師！您可以把您智慧的精華都告訴我嗎？這樣我就能變得像您一樣聰明了。”

老師笑了笑，然後拿起一個蘋果，大大地咬了一口。老師看著他的學生，嘴裡不斷咀嚼著蘋果。過了一會兒，老師把已經嚼爛的蘋果吐在手中，伸出手對這個學生說："把這些吃下去！"學生驚訝地說："老師！這……這怎麼能吃呢？”老師說："我咀嚼過的蘋果，你知道不能吃。其實，我擁有的智慧的精華就像這咀嚼過的蘋果，我可以直接給你，但它已經失去了原來新鮮而甜美的滋味了。學習需要親自去咀嚼和體會，許多答案只有經過你自己的思考才能得到。”
pinyin_paragraphs: céng jīng， yǒu yī gè xué shēng duì zì jǐ de lǎo shī shuō：" lǎo shī！ nín kě yǐ bǎ nín zhì huì de jīng huá dōu gào su wǒ ma？ zhè yàng wǒ jiù néng biàn de xiàng nín yī yàng cōng míng le。”

lǎo shī xiào le xiào， rán hòu ná qǐ yī gè píng guǒ， dà dà de yǎo le yī kǒu。 lǎo shī kàn zhe tā de xué shēng， zuǐ lǐ bù duàn jǔ jué zhe píng guǒ。 guò le yī huì r， lǎo shī bǎ yǐ jīng jiáo làn de píng guǒ tǔ zài shǒu zhōng， shēn chū shǒu duì zhè gè xué shēng shuō：" bǎ zhè xiē chī xià qù！" xué shēng jīng yà de shuō：" lǎo shī！ zhè …… zhè zěn me néng chī ne？” lǎo shī shuō：" wǒ jǔ jué guo de píng guǒ， nǐ zhī dào bù néng chī。 qí shí， wǒ yōng yǒu de zhì huì de jīng huá jiù xiàng zhè jǔ jué guo de píng guǒ， wǒ kě yǐ zhí jiē gěi nǐ， dàn tā yǐ jīng shī qù le yuán lái xīn xiān ér tián měi de zī wèi le。 xué xí xū yào qīn zì qù jǔ jué hé tǐ huì， xǔ duō dá àn zhǐ yǒu jīng guò nǐ zì jǐ de sī kǎo cái néng dé dào。”
english_paragraphs: Once, a student asked his teacher, “Teacher, could you tell me the essence of all your wisdom? Then I could become as wise as you.”

The teacher smiled, picked up an apple, and took a big bite. He looked at his student as he chewed it. After a while, he spat the chewed-up apple into his hand and held it out to the student. “Eat this!” he said. The student exclaimed in surprise, “Teacher! How... how could I eat that?” The teacher replied, “You know you can’t eat an apple I’ve already chewed. The essence of my wisdom is like this chewed-up apple. I could give it to you directly, but it would have lost its original fresh, sweet taste. To learn, you need to chew things over and experience them for yourself. Many answers can only be found through your own thinking.”
english_full:
Once, a student asked his teacher, “Teacher, could you tell me the essence of all your wisdom? Then I could become as wise as you.”

The teacher smiled, picked up an apple, and took a big bite. He looked at his student as he chewed it. After a while, he spat the chewed-up apple into his hand and held it out to the student. “Eat this!” he said. The student exclaimed in surprise, “Teacher! How... how could I eat that?” The teacher replied, “You know you can’t eat an apple I’ve already chewed. The essence of my wisdom is like this chewed-up apple. I could give it to you directly, but it would have lost its original fresh, sweet taste. To learn, you need to chew things over and experience them for yourself. Many answers can only be found through your own thinking.”
